column1: # <tissue> <mark> <ENCFF accession or download URL>
# Seven marks only: atac h3k4me3 h3k27ac h3k27me3 h3k9me3 h3k36me3 h3k4me1
# H3K9ac and DNase are NOT model inputs -- TABULAR_FEATURES fixes the context
# vector at seven tissue-specific features, and an eighth would change the
# epigenomic tower's input dimension and stop being the published architecture.
# Notes must start with '#' or they are parsed as picks.
# ROUTE A, adopted 11 Sep 2026. Every tissue uses a ready-made bulk
# fold-change-over-control bigWig on GRCh38 -- no BAMs, no local conversion, no
# unrecorded parameters. Route B (snATAC BAMs converted with a fixed
# bamCoverage command) is dead: it existed only to keep MCF-10A as the breast
# context, and the context ablation replaced MCF-10A with primary breast
# epithelium, which HAS bulk ATAC. See LAB_NOTES section 1.10.
# ALL FOUR TISSUES ARE PINNED.
# Breast must be pinned: it is already downloaded and already trained on. The
# single-tissue reprocessing (seeds 42/43/44, folds 1-3) used exactly these
# seven files, and the joint model must read the same bytes or the two models
# are not comparable. Auto-resolution could silently pick a different file from
# the same experiment.
# The other three are pinned because the accessions already exist: the ATAC
# files were chosen by hand on 11 Sep 2026, and the eighteen histone files were
# collected under Route B, where only the ATAC entries were route-specific.
# Pinning all of them means ONE command verifies all 28 files.
# How to run, on a LOGIN NODE (compute nodes have no outbound HTTPS):
#   # 1. verify all 28 files without downloading anything
#   python -u data/acquire_multitissue_inputs.py --context-only \
#       --picks data/multitissue_picks.tsv
#   # 2. only once every line passes and the set is consistent
#   python -u data/acquire_multitissue_inputs.py \
#       --picks data/multitissue_picks.tsv --apply
# Step 1 prints per-file verification and then the consistency verdict across
# all four tissues. The line to look for is "Cross-tissue consistent: every
# feature uses the same assay and output type in all tissues", followed by the
# assay list.
# The likely failure: breast epithelium histones are standard Histone ChIP-seq
# while some of the Route B picks may be Mint-ChIP-seq, or vice versa. The check
# refuses the download and tells you to pin HISTONE_ASSAYS. Do that rather than
# forcing -- a mark measured by a different assay in different tissues encodes
# the assay alongside the biology, and a joint model will learn it as tissue
# identity. If a histone pick is rejected outright (hg19, wrong output type),
# the rejection names the parent experiment to search for a sibling file.
# The four tissues, their TCGA solid-tissue-normal donor counts, and the
# training rows each gets under a ~345k budget with disjoint probe sets:
#   BreastEpithelium   TCGA-BRCA              97 donors    ~86k probes
#   KidneyCortex       TCGA-KIRC             205 donors    ~86k probes
#   Lung               TCGA-LUAD + LUSC       74 donors    ~86k probes
#   ColonTransverse    TCGA-COAD + READ       45 donors    ~86k probes
# Colon is the weakest arm: a target median over 45 donors is a noisier label
# than one over 205. Disclose it, and consider donor-weighting rather than an
# even split.
BreastEpithelium:

h3k4me3   ENCFF653CLL
h3k4me1   ENCFF234JZW
h3k27me3  ENCFF212ZFW
